ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity contrast with approximately 85-90% white/high-value pixels across the interior surface and 10-15% low-intensity/black pixels along the perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white interior. Dark black pigmentation is mapped strictly to the trailing edge perimeter, the median notch border, and distal tips. Isolated dark pixel clusters are visible in the lower-central region and mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an obtuse calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe shows more pronounced, irregular peaks compared to the smoother, larger-scale wave-like variations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the median notch extending to pointed, slightly posterior-tilted distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized dark pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) at the lower central margin and three distinct points on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, low-contrast vertical linear disruptions visible in the lower center of the fluke, breaking the uniform white pigmentation.
